question: A cylindrical oil tank has a radius of 5 m and a total surface area of 628 m², what would be its curved surface area? (round off to the second decimal place)
solution:

A cylindrical oil tank has a radius of 5 m and a total surface area of 628 m².

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)
